verdict.rationale: No evidence in the pack addresses telemetry collection or an opt-out mechanism for ADK; the docs cover agent building, deployment, evaluation, and workflows but never mention usage tracking or privacy controls. This is a fair axis for a developer framework/SDK, but absence of evidence means it counts as none. missing for 10: any mention of telemetry collection, an opt-out flag/env var, or a privacy policy describing data tracking.
